Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the answers — quick technical follow-up with concrete examples and recommendations so you can evaluate locally: 

Auth options (recommended)
- Dev/test: API key stored in local env (.env) and in CI secrets — easiest to run quickstarts.
- Production: OIDC (Okta) via short-lived tokens + workload identity; Redwood supports OIDC token exchange for short-lived API tokens that map to tenant scoping. We can provide an example using Authlib (Python) or oidc-client (TS).

Python local quickstart snippet (concept):
- Use our redwood SDK package (pip install redwood-sdk)
- Local fallback: export REDWOOD_API_KEY and run sample app that hits the hosted endpoint.
- Production: configure OIDC token exchange and set REDWOOD_AUTH_PROVIDER=okta with redirect flow for admin onboarding.

Routing and structured output
- Routing: for low-latency paths, tag requests with route:fast and use small-model variants. For high-quality long completions, route:accuracy -> larger model. We'll provide example middleware for tagging by intent.
- Structured output/tool calling: our SDK supports tool/schema hints (JSON schema) to enforce structured outputs for downstream parsing. Good pattern for your summarized customer responses.

Embeddings + reranker guidance
- For 150k docs: recommend 1536-d embeddings (or 1024 if constrained), store in FAISS/Elastic with IVF+PQ for speed.
- Quantization: int8/4-bit quant can be reasonable for embeddings storage (not for model inference) — tradeoffs documented in attached doc.
- Reranker: use a lightweight cross-encoder for top-100 candidates; we can provide a managed reranker that calls Redwood Hosted with small models to re-score.

Network/security notes
- For private VPCs we support private endpoints and customer-managed peering. Please send a high-level network diagram (attached: placeholder).

Actionables from us
- I'll drop a short repo link with runnable Python + TS quickstarts and an OIDC example by EOD Tue.
- Jonas will prepare a brief note on model routing defaults and latency estimates for the QPS you listed.

Thanks —
